THE DETAILS MATTER.

Credits
& sources.

Reference photography

The burgundy 1968 Chevrolet Corvair photograph is by Don O’Brien, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 2.0.

View the original source on Wikimedia Commons ↗

The image has been resized and cropped for the website. Some placements apply a color treatment. It shows a reference vehicle, not the Legacy Garage 26 restoration car. The source identifies the vehicle as a 1968 Corvair; no specific trim is claimed here.

The interactive model

Corvair Anatomy is the existing interactive model project incorporated into this website. It includes 13 functional assemblies and 4,284 selectable model objects. Its explanatory content is currently in Chinese.

The model is a tool for structural learning. Its modeled details, dimensions, and exploded arrangement should not be treated as factory specifications or a verified workshop procedure.

The viewer uses Three.js, distributed under the MIT license.
